# Strictons

> Strictons designs a printed and digital guide that hotels hand to guests at
> check-in. It covers the essentials, the hotel's amenities, and a curated set
> of local businesses. It is free to the hotel and funded by the featured
> businesses, who pay for a spot only after the hotel approves the list.
> Strictons is based in Australia and works with hotels across NSW and the ACT.

This site (strictons.com) is the marketing and information site for Strictons.
The pages below are the canonical entry points for understanding what Strictons
is and who it is for.

## Pages

- [Home](https://strictons.com/): What Strictons is and who it is for.
- [How It Works](https://strictons.com/how-it-works): What the guide does for a hotel, why it is free, and how it comes together.
- [The Live Version](https://strictons.com/live-version): How guests use the live guide for directions, bookings, offers, and hotel services.
- [For Business](https://strictons.com/for-business): The value of a spot in a hotel's guide, the live page, and monthly scan reporting.
- [Guide Specs](https://strictons.com/guide-specs): Physical specifications of the printed guide (size, paper, binding, keycard die-cuts, print partner).
- [FAQs](https://strictons.com/faq): Common questions about the guide, for hotels and for local businesses.
- [Contact](https://strictons.com/contact): How to get in touch and book a meeting.
- [Privacy Policy](https://strictons.com/privacy): How Strictons handles personal information.
- [Website Terms](https://strictons.com/terms): Terms that apply when using the Strictons website.

## Contact
